items.title: EIA Cuts Henry Hub Price Forecast Even as Natural Gas Storage Outlook Tightens
items.summary: Federal forecasters cut more than 100 Bcf from their end-of-October storage forecast, but the slimmer supply cushion failed to lift their Henry Hub price forecast.

items.title: Energy Transfer Builds Permian Natural Gas Reach With $2.6B Vaquero Buy
items.summary: Energy Transfer is expanding its Permian Basin natural gas footprint with a $2.625 billion acquisition of Vaquero Midstream, adding a substantial gathering and processing network in the core of the Delaware sub-basin.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Find New Life Above $3
items.summary: Natural gas futures advanced through early afternoon trade Tuesday as another production estimate kept supply concerns in focus, even as the weather outlook offered mixed support for demand.

items.title: Can Technical Support Near $3 Hold for Natural Gas Futures?
items.summary: Technical support around the $3.00/MMBtu handle held for November natural gas futures to start the week, but choppy trading indicated the prompt month could again test that price floor.

items.title: Most Natural Gas Hubs Lag 2025 Prices, but Some Defy the Trend
items.summary: About four in 10 North American natural gas hubs are trading above year-ago levels as the autumn shoulder season sets in, down from more than 90% in late August when summer refused to loosen its grip on the thermostat.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Extend Winning Streak Despite Weather Weakness
items.summary: Tightening supply-demand balances fueled a third straight positive session for natural gas futures on Tuesday, despite largely unsupportive two-week weather forecasts.

items.title: Global Natural Gas Prices Climb as Hormuz Attacks Heighten Winter LNG Supply Risks
items.summary: European and Asian natural gas prices moved steadily higher Tuesday as Iranian attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continued with no clear signs of tensions easing with the United States.
